SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date April 23, 1940.
Subject Dr. Paul Lederer, Honorary Consul for the Republic of Haiti.

Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No REGISTRY
A. S. R. 9801 (c)
Branch 238 valuation 40

Dr. Paul Lederer, age 60 years, who
describes himself as Honorary Consul for the
Republic of Haiti, arrived in Shanghai on March
15th, 1940, aboard the S.S. "TITANIA", from
Manila and has since been residing in the
Metropole Hotel together with his niece, Miss
G. Lederer, who is stated to be in possession of
a French Passport. He will take up residence in
the Brookside Apartments, 433-5 Avenue Haig, on
May 1st, 1940.

According to information from a reliable
source, he is a German Jew, who at one time worked
for either Carlowitz and Company or Deutsche
Farben Handelsgesellschaft Waibel and Company,
in China but, examination of copies of the China
Hong List back as far as 1920 and enquiries in
various directions have failed to confirm this.
From the same source it has been learned that he
is in possession of considerable means. He has
not yet received his exequatur from the National
Government at Chungking but claims that he contacted
an agent of the Chungking Government recently in
Hongkong to whom he showed his credentials and
also that he is well known to Mr. Wellington Koo,
Chinese Ambassador to France. It has been learned
that he was in Hongkong in January, 1940 and it is
possible that it was during this visit that he came

事由：保罗·莱德勒（Paul Lederer）博士，海地共和国名誉领事。

制作人：D.S.I. 洛根（Logan） 转呈人：D. I. 克劳福德（Crawford）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 登记处
A. S. R. 9801 (c)
分科 238 估值 40

保罗·莱德勒（Paul Lederer）博士，60岁，自称海地共和国名誉领事，于1940年3月15日乘坐“提塔尼亚”号（S.S. "TITANIA"）轮船从马尼拉抵达上海，此后一直与其侄女G. 莱德勒小姐（Miss G. Lederer）同住于大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel），据称该侄女持有法国护照。他将于1940年5月1日迁入海格路433-5号布鲁克赛德公寓（Brookside Apartments）。

根据可靠消息来源的情报，他是一名德国犹太人，曾在中国为卡洛维茨公司（Carlowitz and Company）或德意志染料贸易公司魏贝尔公司（Deutsche Farben Handelsgesellschaft Waibel and Company）工作，但查阅追溯至1920年的《在华洋行名录》（China Hong List）副本并进行多方查询后，均未能证实此事。从同一消息源获悉，他拥有巨额资产。他尚未收到重庆国民政府颁发的领事委任状（exequatur），但声称近期在香港接触过重庆政府的一名代理人，并向其出示了 credentials（_credentials_一词原文如此，通常指委任证书或凭证），还称自己为中国驻法国大使顾维钧先生所熟知。据悉，他于1940年1月曾在香港，很可能是在此次访问期间与重庆政府的代理人取得了联系。

According to information contained in Police
records, he is related to a Dr. R.E. Kahn,
German Jew, who at one time practised as a Barrister
in Shanghai and, during one of his visits to
Shanghai, resided with Dr. Kahn at 383 Great Western
Road. Dr. Kahn left Shanghai for Australia some
two years ago. Lederer is known to have travelled
extensively in China and Thibet, supposedly in
the interests of "Defag".

He is stated to have become a naturalized
citizen of Haiti in May, 1939 by virtue of the
fact that he purchased an interest in a pineapple
plantation to the value of U.S.$5,000.00. This
transaction also enabled him to procure his
appointment as Haitian Honorary Consul in Shanghai.

As there are few, if any, Haitians in
Shanghai, it is reasonable to view Lederer with suspicion
especially when it is borne in mind that there is
a large foreign refugee population in Shanghai
anxious to obtain passports which would enable them
to travel freely and who are no doubt willing to
pay handsomely to obtain same. There is reason
also to believe that the British Authorities are
suspicious of Lederer's activities and that the
same applies to the French Authorities where

据警务处档案记录所载情报，他与R.E. 卡恩（R.E. Kahn）博士有亲属关系，卡恩博士也是一名德国犹太人，曾一度在上海以律师身份执业；在莱德勒某次访问上海期间，他曾与大西路383号的卡恩博士同住。卡恩博士约于两年前离开上海前往澳大利亚。众所周知，莱德勒曾广泛游历中国及西藏，据称是代表“Defag”（德意志染料贸易公司）的利益。

据称，他于1939年5月通过购买价值5,000美元的菠萝种植园股份而成为海地归化公民。这笔交易也使他得以获得上海海地名誉领事的任命。

由于在上海的海地人寥寥无几（如果有的话），因此有理由对莱德勒持怀疑态度，特别是考虑到上海有大量外籍难民迫切希望获得能使其自由旅行的护照，且无疑愿意为此支付重金。此外，也有理由相信英国当局对莱德勒的活动持怀疑态度，法国当局亦然，因为

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........

S. 1, Special Branch Shanghai
REPORT                        Date February 24, 19 40.

Subject ....... Paul LEDERER.

Made by. D.I.J. Killingsbeck    Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

With reference to the attached enquiry
concerning one Paul LEDERER, this person is
apparently identical with a Dr. Paul Lederer who
was last heard of in Shanghai during 1938.
Dr. LEDERER is a German Jew and is related to
a Dr. R.E. KAHN, also a German Jew, who was
at one time practising as a Barrister in Shanghai.
During LEDERER's stay in Shanghai, he was for
a time living with Dr. KAHN, at 383 Great Western
Road.

There is no record of Paul Lederer on
file at Police Headquarters and he is not known
amongst the local Jewish Community. Enquiries
made have failed to reveal anything concerning
his associates or social activities. It is
stated, however, that up till the time he left
Shanghai, he was in a very high position in
the large German dye and colour works, "Deutsche
Farben-Handels-Gesellschaft", more commonly
known as "DEFAG". It is not known whether he is
still connected with this firm, but, owing to the
fact that he was officially known as the Director
of the firm, it is very likely that he still has
connections with "DEFAG".

During the time Lederer was in Shanghai,
he often made trips to all parts of China and
has even been as far North as Lhasa in Thibet.

FILE
（印：Q）

DATE 26/ 2/ 40

关于附函中查询一名名为保罗·莱德勒（Paul LEDERER）的人士一事，此人显然与1938年在上海最后被提及的保罗·莱德勒博士为同一人。莱德勒博士是一名德国犹太人，与同样身为德国犹太人的R.E. 卡恩（R.E. KAHN）博士有亲属关系，卡恩博士曾一度在上海以律师身份执业。在莱德勒逗留上海期间，他曾有一段时间与大西路383号的卡恩博士同住。

警察总局档案中没有保罗·莱德勒的记录，当地犹太社区也不认识他。经查询，未能发现有关其交往人员或社交活动的任何信息。然而，据称在他离开上海之前，他在大型德国染料和颜料工厂“德意志染料贸易公司”（Deutsche Farben-Handels-Gesellschaft），即更广为人知的“DEFAG”，担任高位。目前尚不清楚他是否仍与该公司有关联，但由于他官方身份为该公司董事，他很可能仍与“DEFAG”保持联系。

在莱德勒身处上海期间，他经常前往中国各地旅行，甚至北至西藏拉萨。

归档
（印：Q）

It was generally believed that these trips were
all on business connected with this firm. During
the Summer of 1938, Lederer is reported to have
told people in the town that he had just returned
from a trip to the Himalaya Mountains in India.
With reference to Dr. K.E. Kahn, who is
thought to be an uncle of Lederer's, this man
left Shanghai for Australia about two years ago,
as he wished to adopt British Nationality. He
is a member of the English Bar and practised in
England for a short time. He was not allowed to
practise in the British Court in Shanghai,
apparently, as he was not in possession of British
Nationality papers.

（批：C953.）

人们普遍认为，这些旅行均是与该公司业务有关的公务。据报道，1938年夏季，莱德勒曾告诉镇上的人，他刚从印度喜马拉雅山脉旅行归来。
关于K.E. 卡恩（K.E. Kahn）博士，此人被认为是莱德勒的叔父，约于两年前离开上海前往澳大利亚，因为他希望取得英国国籍。他是英格兰律师公会成员，并在英国短暂执业。他未获准在上海的英国法院执业，显然是因为他不持有英国国籍证明文件。

SECRET
February 3rd, 1940.

I should be grateful for any information
available concerning an individual of German
origin named PAUL LEDERER who became a naturalized
citizen of Haiti in May, 1939, by virtue of the
fact that he purchased an interest in a pineapple
plantation to the value of US$5,000. This invest-
ment, according to his story, also procured his
appointment as Haytian Consul in Shanghai where he
has apparently been resident between 1933 and 1938.
He is at present in Manila but is intending to
proceed here at an early date to assume his appoint-
ment. As he will not be permitted again to pass
through Hongkong he will have to find a vessel
coming here direct.

"Y"

机密
1940年2月3日。

如能提供有关一名名为保罗·莱德勒（PAUL LEDERER）的德裔人士的任何现有情报，我将不胜感激。他于1939年5月通过购买价值5,000美元的菠萝种植园股份而成为海地归化公民。据其自述，这笔投资也使他获得了上海海地领事的任命，他显然在1933年至1938年间居住于此。他目前身在马尼拉，但打算不久后前来此地就职。由于他将不再被允许经由香港过境，他必须寻找一艘直接驶往此地的船只。

"Y"
